result.summary: High frequency failed API key and token authentication requests, as well as a directory traversal probe, were blocked by the API gateway filter from IP 198.51.100.89. Unauthorized access attempts were also detected and blocked.

confidence.rationale: The detection event ID (DET-SCAN-01) is strongly correlated with multiple evidence IDs (EV-SCAN-01, EV-SCAN-02, EV-REQ-03, EV-ACCESS-04) and has a high confidence level.
limitations: No direct evidence of successful unauthorized access or data access

observedFacts.statement: 10 failed API key authentication requests from IP 198.51.100.89 against /vault/v1/secrets
15 failed token authentication attempts from IP 198.51.100.89
Directory traversal probe GET /../../etc/shadow from IP 198.51.100.89 returning 400 Bad Request
Unauthorized access attempt against /admin/keys from IP 198.51.100.89 blocked with 403 Forbidden
